calls.title: Friday One Off Check-in
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the initial complexities in the onboarding process, with Elyse Fox and Ashley Stirrup noting that early confusion was diminishing thanks to clearer explanations and plans for a cheat sheet on key statistical terminology. They also discussed competitive pricing strategies, emphasizing the importance of usage-based and modular pricing models. Ashley particularly highlighted insights from competitor pricing, such as PostHog's event-based costs, which served as a benchmark for their pricing model. Additionally, they explored flexible pricing that could accommodate AI usage spikes. Towards the end, a weekly marketing tracker was introduced to streamline communications and enhance cross-team awareness, ensuring that updates remain clear and engaging.
calls.keywords: onboarding, pricing strategy, usage-based pricing, experimentation, AI integration, competitive analysis
calls.action_items:
**Elyse Fox**
Share the competitive pricing analysis link and continue building out and refining the pricing breakdown with a focus on key modules and usage models (03:14)
Validate the final breakdown of pricing categories with Ashley before completing the full analysis (12:13)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide a concise cheat sheet on statistical terminology (Bayesian vs. Frequentist) for internal and sales use (01:36)
Review Elyse’s pricing category breakdown and offer feedback on relevance and strategic focus (11:30)
Support Elyse in estimating competitor pricing models based on event/experiment usage for comparison with internal models (07:30)
Implement and maintain weekly marketing tracker updates for the extended marketing team and share notable accomplishments (16:40)
